Yes, the Parthenon is much older, by about 500 years. Work on it started in Athens in 447 BC, and the building itself was finished in 438 BC. Work on its sculptures and decoration went on until about 432 BC [1][2]. The Colosseum went up between AD 70 and 80, so the Parthenon was already more than five centuries old by then.
